prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic studio ecommerce product image for the Brazilian running event NO PIQUE COM POLLY. Reference 1 is the official shirt: use its hot-pink #F50082 and electric cyan #00D5F4 brand palette and exact condensed italic stacked NO PIQUE / com / POLLY lettering as brand guidance. Reference 2 is the campaign: use the pictured accessory styling only where relevant. Photography: portrait 4:5 frame, neutral medium-gray seamless studio backdrop and floor matching the shirt reference, soft diffused premium lighting, realistic materials and subtle contact shadow. Show the entire single product large and centered with generous safety margins on ALL sides so a carousel never crops it. No people, no hands, no other products, no floating editorial text, no captions, no prices, no watermark. Brand lettering may appear only as printing on the product itself, text verbatim NO PIQUE com POLLY. Subject: one hot-pink reusable sports squeeze water bottle standing upright, matte polymer finish, a practical black screw-top sports cap with cyan drinking spout. A clean cyan NO PIQUE com POLLY logo is printed on the front, matching the lettering on the reference shirt. Subtle cyan diagonal speed lines near the base. Three-quarter front view, complete bottle including cap and base. Do not print a volume or technical specifications.
